# approval-workflow

> Multi-level approval engine: amount-based routing, sequential levels with quorums, separation of duties, time-bound delegation, escalation on timeout and terminal states. Python package `approval_workflow`, import name `approval_workflow`, MIT licensed, no runtime dependencies.

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example, public API, limits

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): the acceptance test module in this snapshot
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): package shape, lifecycle, time and bounds
- [Stack](docs/STACK.md): runtime and discarded tools
